comments.body: I've been attacked by Ottoman flagged navy in the Black Sea and Red Sea but have never attacked them. By the way, Caution prevents ambushes (when ships attack you out of nowhere) only. Not sure how that works... either your levels or your ships levels (or a combination, perhaps) determines if you will be attacked or not.

comments.author: Curious
comments.body: There are NPCs in all Major Cities called "Merchant" that look identical to the Pedlar NPCs. They also sell Ceasefires. They might also be in other ports too but I haven't really been paying attention so just keep a look out.

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body:
You can buy these in the following ports:
St.Petersburg (when Gran Atlas comes out)
Stockholm
Oslo
Algiers
Tunis
Sierra Leone
Saint-Georges
Luanda
Cape Town
Calicut

And FYI... they work in regions that you open up with fame (Africa, Red Sea, India, even Carib) but not in areas that you open with Imp quests (East coast, SE asia, etc)
